variants.headline: Home world answers colony's petition
variants.body: The home world has answered the colony's petition. We judge the stewardship of {target} inadequate; practical responsibility should be assessed against a demanding standard.

variants.headline: A reply to the colonial petition
variants.body: A reply to the colony's petition has come from the home world. We judge the stewardship of {target} inadequate; practical responsibility should be assessed against a demanding standard.

variants.headline: Petition receives an answer
variants.body: The colony has received an answer to its petition from the home world. We judge the stewardship of {target} inadequate; practical responsibility should be assessed against a demanding standard.
